item.title: Forget security guards, an Australian town is using classical music to stop people hanging around
item.description: Swan Hill, Australia, is deterring vandalism and late-night hangouts at public toilets by playing classical music. The local council opted for this unusual sound-based approach, featuring pieces like Wagner's 'Ride of the Valkyries,' to make the area less inviting for disruptive behaviour. Early results indicate a noticeable drop in incidents.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Villagers drank sinkhole water as a 'miracle cure', until officials found dangerous bacteria
item.description: Residents in West Sumatra are warned against drinking water from a new sinkhole after tests revealed E. coli contamination. Locals flocked to the site, believing the water had healing properties, but authorities emphasize it's unsafe and potentially dangerous. The sinkhole's formation is attributed to geological conditions and heavy rainfall, highlighting the risks of consuming untreated water.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Who is Jayda Cheaves? Influencer sparks buzz after appearing to confirm Lil Baby and Ari Fletcher rumors
item.description: Fresh rumors link rapper Lil Baby to influencer Ari Fletcher, prompting a response from his ex, Jayda Cheaves. During a TikTok livestream, Cheaves confirmed the whispers held truth but opted for peace over further discussion. The couple, who share a son, officially ended their relationship in September 2022, with neither Lil Baby nor Fletcher commenting publicly on the latest speculation.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: ‘Packed with Indians’: Japanese YouTuber Ikechan stirs row with 'racist' Air India comment
item.description: Ikechan, a Japanese YouTuber, found herself in hot water after a social media post regarding her flight to India, where she referred to the aircraft as 'full of Indians.' This comment provoked a significant backlash, leading many to accuse her of racism and disrespect towards Indian culture.
item.dc:creator: TOI Trending Desk

item.title: “We don't need approval”: Nick Fuentes sparks backlash after saying Clavicular represents what young men need
item.description: Nick Fuentes trended after a viral clip showed him praising rapper Clavicular, using provocative language to argue that young white men should embrace assertiveness. Influencer Sneako echoed the sentiment, framing it as cultural self-confidence. The moment sparked backlash over tone, intent, and normalizing aggression, while supporters called it unfiltered honesty. Algorithms amplified the clip, pushing it toward six-figure views quickly.
item.dc:creator: Barsha Dutta

item.title: IShowSpeed reveals himself as AFCON final mascot during Morocco vs Senegal
item.description: During the AFCON 2025 final, internet personality IShowSpeed surprised tens of thousands of fans by revealing himself as the tournament mascot, "Assad." This unexpected moment, captured and shared widely on social media, turned the match into a viral sensation and highlighted the growing integration of online creators into major sporting events.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Adin Ross net worth timeline (2016 to 2026): From small Twitch streams to a $24 million fortune
item.description: Adin Ross transformed from a struggling Twitch streamer in 2016 to a multi-millionaire by 2025. His journey saw a meteoric rise fueled by viral content, a lucrative Kick deal worth over $10 million, and strategic investments. This shift propelled his net worth to an estimated $24 million, showcasing the dramatic potential of online content creation.

item.title: Stranger Things gets sequels, spin-offs, and Episode 9 'Conformity Gate' in new SNL sketch
item.description: SNL kicked off 2026 by hilariously imagining Stranger Things sequels, spin-offs, and absurd reboots. Highlights included Steve as a forever-teen drama teacher, Nancy covering the O.J. chase, Mike gossiping in Manhattan while writing a coming-of-age story about Eleven, and Ted Wheeler oblivious to Demogorgons. The sketch skewered franchise excess, viral fan obsessions like Conformity Gate, and the show’s long-running quirks, blending cringe and comedy.

item.title: ‘Karenesque’: Lara Trump’s viral dance sparks cringe and brutal takes on her music career
item.description: Lara Trump, wife of Eric Trump, has resurfaced online dancing with Egyptian rapper Mohamed Ramadan for an upcoming music video. This marks her latest venture into the music industry, following previous releases and a collaboration with French Montana. The clip, filmed at Trump National Golf Club, has sparked considerable online criticism and mockery from netizens.

item.title: Middle East: Trump invited PM Shehbaz Sharif to join Gaza 'Board of Peace', says Pakistan
item.description: Pakistan has been invited by US President Donald Trump to join the Gaza “Board of Peace,” a key element of his roadmap to end the Gaza conflict. The foreign office confirmed the invitation, stating Pakistan will engage with international initiatives for stability and a long-term solution to the Palestine issue in line with UN resolutions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Watch: Andrew Tate, Nick Fuentes and others caught dancing to 'Heil Hitler', netizens shout 'sinister'
item.description: A viral video shows controversial internet personalities Andrew Tate, Nick Fuentes, and others singing along to Kanye West's banned song 'Heil Hitler' on a bus. The clip, featuring the antisemitic lyric, has sparked widespread outrage online. These influencers, with millions of followers, were reportedly en route to a nightclub in Miami, further fueling criticism of their public actions.

item.title: SNL sketch gives Harry Potter’s Harry and Ron a steamy romance inspired by HBO’s ‘Heated Rivalry’
item.description: A Saturday Night Live sketch has folded Heated Rivalry into pop-culture shorthand, spoofing the HBO hockey romance through a Harry Potter parody packed with innuendo. With Finn Wolfhard, Ben Marshall and a surprise Jason Momoa cameo, the sketch reflects how quickly the series, already renewed for season two, has travelled from niche hit to mainstream reference point.
